title: Business-Wrap edits file
description: Ordered list of human edits made in the HTML editor on top of a document JSON. Replaying ops in order on the base document (matched by baseHash) must give the edited document. Targets are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers into the document JSON (e.g. /chapters/2/sections/0/blocks/1/rows/3/2). Pointers are resolved against the document state AFTER all previous ops.

baseHash.description: sha256 of the base document JSON bytes the ops apply to. Replay refuses on mismatch.

locale.description: Edition edited. ar = RTL, en = LTR.

author.description: Free text initials; never an email or ID number.

id.description: Optional op id for undo/redo bookkeeping.

oneOf.description: Replace a string leaf (paragraph, cell, title, caption). old = previous text, for conflict check and undo.
Insert value into an array; path ends with the target index or '-' for append (block, row, column cell, paragraph, story).
Remove the array item or object member at path. old = removed value, for undo.
Move the node at from to path (JSON Patch move semantics). Used for drag-reorder of blocks, rows, sections.
Copy the array item at path and insert it at to (default: right after path).

themeOverrides.description: Token overrides by DTCG token path (e.g. 'color.accent.primary', 'type.size.body'), value in the token's own type. Applied on top of the design pack.
